The remittance of the 1st and 2nd Tranches shall be made within the 3rd and 4th quarters of

The disposition of the said funds by the National Liga ng mga Barangay
shall be in accordance with the pertinent provisions of its Constitution and By-Laws on
the sharing scheme for collected membership dues, and subject to applicable accounting
and auditing rules and regulations.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
